headings.style: font-black, tracking-tighter, uppercase or tight leading for high impact. Never use Inter for headings.

body.family: IBM Plex Mono or Geist Mono
body.style: Technical, sterile, authoritative. Optimal for data and interface elements.

colors.rules: Color is function only. 95% of the UI must be monochrome. Never use full-screen gradients. Use pure high-contrast neutral scales.

/demo.flow: Problem Statement Input -> Role -> Department -> Industry -> Summary -> Selected MacBook Film
/demo.notes: Persist problem in URL. Background kinetic animation.

/investor.flow: Timed system formation gateway -> Venture / Strategic / Operator
/investor.notes: Strictly investor paths. Remove any customer options.

/demo/workspace.flow: Moved from previous /demo to this new route.

routes.legacy_redirects: Ensure old /demo customer deep links redirect to /demo/customer/:role/:department/:industry while maintaining query parameters.

kinetic_background.concept: Vanishing carousel / perspective motion framing the Problem input.
kinetic_background.choreography: Three distinct streams: 1. 'DITCH THE STITCHING' (SaaS tools) moving inward and collapsing into the center Ahi core. 2. 'CONNECT THE SOURCES' (Connectors) feeding continuously into the core. 3. Ahi Capabilities radiating and emerging from the center.
kinetic_background.implementation: Use Framer Motion with 3D transforms (scale, rotateX, rotateY, translateZ, opacity). Texts should exist in 3D space, heavily blurred at distance, sharpening as they approach. Text-only execution (no 3rd party logos needed).
kinetic_background.mobile_safe: Reduce density and speed on mobile. Ensure tap controls and input fields remain above the Z-index of animations.
kinetic_background.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by falling back to static faint text grids with simple opacity fades.

problem_gateway.layout: Center stage overlaying the kinetic background. Glassmorphism container (crystal variant) to separate from moving text.
problem_gateway.interactions: Large fluid input for 'What problem are you solving?'. Below it, 3-4 suggested problem prompts for fast entry.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute route split: /demo for customers, /investor for investors, /demo/workspace for the full explorer.
Implement the progressive customer decision flow on /demo: Problem -> Role -> Dept -> Industry -> Summary.
Pass the entered Problem string via URL state to the final MacBook film so it contextualizes the demo.
Build the kinetic background component using Framer Motion with the provided 50/50/50 inventory lists.
Ensure 'DITCH THE STITCHING' and 'CONNECT THE SOURCES' streams have aggressive, dynamic motion collapsing into Ahi.
Maintain the existing live product/MacBook films intact; only update their entry logic.
No generic AI emojis or bloat. Strict monochrome, high-tension Palantir AIP aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Focus on extreme contrast, generous padding (p-8 to p-12 minimum for containers), and optical alignment. Do not center everything; use grids and tension. Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Never use plain transparent backgrounds for overlapping content—always use backdrop-blur or solid fills. Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active). Avoid 'AI slop' gradients; use noise or static grayscale instead.
